### 1. Count outcomes with an even sum  

A sum is even exactly when the two dice have the same parity:

- Both odd: odd faces are \(\{1,3,5\}\), giving \(3\cdot 3 = 9\) outcomes.

We need ordered pairs \((d_1,d_2)\) with \(d_1+d_2=8\) and each die between 1 and 6:

\[
(2,6),\ (3,5),\ (4,4),\ (5,3),\ (6,2).

\[
P(\text{sum}=8 \mid \text{sum even})
= \frac{P(\text{sum}=8 \text{ and even})}{P(\text{sum even})}
